description: Shareable Renovate preset: born-mergeable PRs (release-age gated), daily grouped non-major automerge, minimal CI churn.

packageRules.description: Prod deps (non-major): grouped daily, automerge on green
Dev/tooling deps (non-major): grouped daily, automerge on green
CI/tooling managers (GitHub Actions, Dockerfiles, etc.) ride with dev deps — they were arriving as individual PRs that went stale behind their siblings

Majors automerge too, but stay individual (never grouped) so one breaking bump can't block unrelated updates, and soak longer than the fleet default: a major's early patch releases are where the regressions surface, and CI can only catch what it tests.
